title: Agent Chat: stage_screenshot is delivered to the LLM as base64 TEXT, not an image content part (vision unusable)
description: ## FIXED — stage_screenshot now delivers a real image content part to the model ### Root cause (confirmed) buildAgentTools (packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/tools.ts) defined every tool with only execute returning the raw dispatch result. With no toModelOutput, AI SDK v6 (ai@6.0.208) serialized the stage_screenshot {pngBase64,width,height} result as a type:'json' (text) tool-result, so multimodal models received base64 as undecodable text + a huge context blob. ### Fix tools.ts: added IMAGE_RESULT_COMMANDS = {stage_screenshot} and a per-tool toModelOutput override (AI SDK v6 multimodal tool-result API). It returns { type:'content', value:[{type:'text', text:'Rendered stage screenshot (WxH).'}, {type:'image-data', data: pngBase64, mediaType:'image/png'}] }. A runtime guard (isImageToolResult) passes a structured dispatch error (e.g. editor-not-ready) through as {type:'json'} instead of an image. Other tools keep the generic { description, inputSchema, execute } shape (no toModelOutput) -> still JSON text. Base64 never enters the plain-text channel. v6 API used: tool().toModelOutput(({toolCallId,input,output}) => ToolResultOutput); content part type 'image-data' (preferred over deprecated 'media') from the @ai-sdk/provider-utils ToolResultOutput union. ### Chip AgentChatPanel.tsx ToolChip result section: detects a {pngBase64,width,height} output (isImageToolOutput) and renders a 'screenshot (W x H)' label + small thumbnail (ScreenshotResult) instead of dumping base64 via prettyJson. New toolScreenshot style. ### systemPrompt + docs systemPrompt.ts:34 softened: notes the screenshot returns a real inspectable image only if the model supports vision; text-only models should rely on structured reads. docs/32-agent-chat.md documents the image-tool-result mapping + chip thumbnail + model vision dependency. ### Verification (all in worktree) - pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: PASS - pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run: 811 passed (59 files), incl. 3 new tools.test.ts cases (image-data round-trip; error->json passthrough; non-image tools have no toModelOutput). - pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run: 1462 passed (116 files) — no task-1207 fixture failures observed. - e2e: agent-chat-drives-stage.spec.ts (oracle) PASS; agent-chat-panel-regression.spec.ts 4/4 PASS.
